fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage of Florida Power & Light billing and electric-rate regulation; allegations of abuse and misconduct involving Dr. T. Earl Moore and calls for action by medical authorities and Gov. Warren; commentary on gambling enforcement and proposals affecting racing (including opposition to summer dog racing in Miami); local court and civic items; notices of cultural events (Freedom House Forum presentation of Ibsen’s “Peer Gynt,” veterans dance) and community announcements; and opinion pieces on politics, civil-rights legislation, and tax-avoidance through foundations, along with letters to the editor and local advertising.
